metaTitle: Inside Our Workshop | Land Rover Garage
metaDescription: Take a look inside our Land Rover workshop in Billericay, Essex. See our facilities, equipment, and team of specialist technicians.
lede: A specialist Land Rover engine rebuild and repair facility in Billericay, Essex — equipped to handle everything from classic Tdi to modern Ingenium and BMW-sourced V8s.

blocks.html: Based at Unit A5 Windsor Road, our workshop is purpose-built for Land Rover engine work. We combine modern diagnostic equipment with traditional machining skills to deliver rebuilds, replacements, and repairs across the entire Land Rover range.
Every engine that arrives is inspected, stripped, and rebuilt to our 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty standard — and every rebuild is road-tested before collection.

We work on [Defender](/defender-engines), [Discovery](/discovery-engines), [Range Rover](/landrover-range-rover-tdv6-engines), and all other models — from the 200Tdi and Td5 through to the latest Ingenium and BMW-sourced V8s.
We maintain a full in-house machine shop and diagnostic suite, so we don't rely on external subcontractors for critical work:

items: Two-post and four-post vehicle lifts
Engine cranes and rotating engine stands
Cylinder boring and honing machine
Crankshaft grinding and polishing equipment
Cylinder head resurfacing and pressure testing
JLR SDD / Pathfinder / TOPix diagnostic systems
Specialist timing chain tooling for Ingenium and AJ-V8
Torque-controlled assembly tools and measuring equipment

blocks.html: Having this equipment on-site means we can control quality at every stage — from initial strip-down to final assembly and testing.
Our technicians have specialist experience across the full Land Rover engine range. The team includes:

items: Master technicians with over 15 years of Land Rover experience
In-house machinists skilled in boring, honing, and crankshaft grinding
Diagnostic specialists trained on JLR systems
Apprentices trained in-house to maintain our standards

blocks.html: We invest in ongoing training to keep up with new engine developments — including the BMW-sourced V8s and mild-hybrid systems.
[Learn more about our team and history →](/about)

steps.title: Inspection & Quotation
steps.body: We assess your engine on-site, provide a fixed-price quote, and agree a timeline.

steps.title: Strip-Down & Machining
steps.body: We strip the engine, inspect every component, and perform required machining in-house.

steps.title: Rebuild & Assembly
steps.body: We rebuild using genuine or OEM-spec parts, following Land Rover torque and clearance specifications.

steps.title: Testing & Road Test
steps.body: We run the engine on the stand, then refit and road-test the vehicle to confirm performance.

steps.title: Collection & Warranty
steps.body: Your vehicle is ready for collection with our 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

items: Specialist Land Rover engine knowledge — from classic to modern
In-house machining and diagnostics — no subcontracting
12-month unlimited-mileage warranty on all rebuilds
Nationwide recovery service available (from £70)
Quote within 30 minutes during working hours
Transparent fixed-price quotes after inspection

items.q: Can I visit the workshop to see my engine being rebuilt?
items.a: Yes — we welcome visits by appointment. We can show you around the workshop and discuss your engine's progress. Please call ahead to arrange a time.

items.q: Do you have a customer waiting area?
items.a: Yes, we have a comfortable reception area with Wi-Fi, refreshments, and a view into the workshop.

items.q: How long does a typical rebuild take?
items.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3–5 working days from arrival. We'll give you a more accurate timeline after inspection.
Yes, we offer nationwide recovery from £70. We can usually arrange collection within a few hours of booking.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on rebuilds?
items.a: All rebuilds come with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.
